basic_details.offering_entity: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation & University of Cambridge
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to any subject available at the University of Cambridge EXCEPT undergraduate degrees, non-degree courses, MBBChir Clinical Medicine, and part-time degrees.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 full-cost scholarships awarded annually (~25 US round, ~55 International round)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; exceptional Pakistani scholars selected in the international round
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full duration of the degree: 1 year for MPhil/LLM; up to 3 to 4 years for PhD

nationality_requirements: A citizen of any country outside the United Kingdom (Pakistani citizens eligible)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 16 years of education (Bachelor's) for Master's; 18 years (Master's) for PhD with first-class academic standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalent to a Cambridge First Class Honours degree (minimum 3.80 / 4.00 CGPA or top 2% class ranking).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Outstanding academic background in proposed discipline with exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final year of undergraduate or master's studies.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Commitment to improving the lives of others, public leadership, and social enterprise evaluated.

english_proficiency.notes: Must satisfy Cambridge department English requirement (typically IELTS Academic 7.5 with no band below 7.0 or TOEFL iBT 110 with 25 in all components).

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Four core criteria: Outstanding intellectual ability, reasons for choice of course, commitment to improving the lives of others, leadership potential.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: University Composition Fee and College Fee at the appropriate international rate fully covered.

admission_application_fee.details: Cambridge graduate application fee (£65 to £75) paid by candidate (fee waivers available for eligible low-income countries upon request).

monthly_stipend.details: Generous maintenance allowance to cover accommodation, food, and living expenses.

airfare.details: One economy single airfare at both the beginning and end of the course.

visa_fee.details: Inbound visa costs (UK Student Route visa) and the Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) fully covered.

health_insurance.details: Full UK National Health Service (NHS) access via covered Immigration Health Surcharge.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Academic development funding of up to £2,000 available to attend conferences and courses.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Fieldwork funding available for PhD research outside Cambridge.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Family allowance available (up to £11,604 for one child, £16,548 for two or more children) for scholars with dependents.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: University of Cambridge (World Top 3).
participating_institutions: University of Cambridge (Trinity, St John's, King's, Churchill, Jesus, Clare, Queens', Fitzwilliam, all 31 colleges)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World Rank #2; world leader in research across all humanities, social sciences, and STEM.
available_majors: Computer Science, Advanced Computer Science, Engineering, Biotechnology, Physics, Applied Mathematics & Theoretical Physics (DAMTP), Public Health, Medical Sciences, Law (LLM), Economics, Public Policy (MPP), International Relations, History, Philosophy
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 1 year for MPhil/LLM; 3 to 4 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Apply for graduate admission to Cambridge via the Postgraduate Applicant Portal and complete the dedicated Gates Cambridge section.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: PhD candidates must have strong alignment with prospective Cambridge supervisor; MPhil is evaluated by departmental committee.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: The 500-word Gates statement must convince the trust of your moral commitment to use your Cambridge education to improve the lives of others.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Cambridge Postgraduate Applicant Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Cambridge Applicant Portal, choose degree course, select 'Yes' for Gates Cambridge funding, and upload Gates reference and statement.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Choose course and check departmental deadline (Round opens September; International deadline: early December or early January depending on course).
2. Write 500-word Gates Cambridge Statement explaining how you meet the scholarship criteria.
3. Secure a dedicated Gates Cambridge Reference Letter in addition to two academic reference letters.
4. Submit complete course and scholarship application before your course deadline.
5. Academic departments rank applicants and put forward top candidates to the Gates Cambridge Trust (January).
6. Shortlisted candidates invited for a 20-25 minute panel interview in late March.
7. Final offers announced in late March/early April.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated single application via the Cambridge Postgraduate Portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees: two academic referees + one specialized Gates referee.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Gates Statement (500 words): Explain why you are applying for a Gates Cambridge Scholarship and how you meet the four scholarship criteria.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a detailed research proposal (typically 2-4 pages); MPhil applicants submit statement of interest.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV highlighting publications, leadership roles, and volunteerism.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20-25 minute virtual panel interview with four distinct components: academic background, why Cambridge, commitment to improving lives, and leadership capacity.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE required only by a few specific departments (e.g. Economics); English language test required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified transcripts and degree certificates; HEC attestation required.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 500-word statement explaining alignment with the four Gates criteria
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Authentic narrative demonstrating leadership and impact in Pakistan

required_documents_checklist.specification: Separate reference speaking specifically to your leadership and commitment to others
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From someone who knows your character, social initiatives, or leadership

required_documents_checklist.specification: Submitted directly by university research professors
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Speaking to academic ranking and intellectual brilliance

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: International round deadline depends on course (either December 3, 2026 or January 7, 2027). Interviews held late March.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Outstanding intellectual ability, first-class degree, rank in class)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 25% (Demonstrated leadership potential and capacity to effect change)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For PhD: quality and originality of research proposal)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Gates Statement articulating commitment to improving lives of others)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Quality of the dedicated Gates reference letter)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Two-tier sift: Cambridge academic departments shortlist top applicants; Gates Cambridge multidisciplinary interviewing panels conduct final interviews.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Equal assessment of four pillars: Intellectual Ability, Reasons for Choice of Course, Commitment to Improving Lives of Others, Leadership Potential.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~80 scholarships awarded globally (~55 in international round)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Scholars combining exceptional academic grades with extraordinary social impact: NGO founders, policy innovators, climate advocates, and scientific researchers.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani universities (LUMS, NUST, AKU, IBA) with prominent public service records.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: USA, India, Pakistan, Canada, China, Germany, Australia, Nigeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized services offering 'Gates interview prep' or essay writing.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pay the Cambridge application fee (£75) only on the official postgraduate portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through agents; Gates Cambridge looks for authentic personal voice and integrity.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial relocation buffer before first stipend release in Cambridge.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: Only PhD students are funded. (Fact: About one-third of Gates Cambridge awards go to 1-year Master's students).
MYTH: You need work experience. (Fact: Academic excellence and leadership potential are primary; work experience is not mandatory).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: External sites claim Gates pays for family in all cases; family allowance is discretionary and requires formal application.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain good academic standing and progress in accordance with University of Cambridge degree regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residence in Cambridge during terms (minimum terms of residence required by university statues).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports submitted by Cambridge faculty supervisor to the Gates Cambridge Trust.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Cambridge University policy restricts graduate students from undertaking outside employment during full-time study, except limited college supervisions/demonstrating (max 6 hrs/week).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are eligible for the UK 2-year Graduate Route visa (or 3-year for PhD) post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None; active engagement with the Gates Cambridge Scholars' Council and alumni network.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated in case of academic failure or withdrawal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from both the university and the Gates Cambridge Trust.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: PhD scholars can apply for up to 6 months of discretionary funding extension if research delays are justified.

data_points_missing_or_unpublished_by_so: Departmental shortlisting cutoff rankings for candidate nomination to the Trust
